q1_issues.issue: "the search" is an event-denoting noun that abandoning terminates, so the event-object clause of the Patient/Theme test (whose enumeration includes the near-synonym "call off") arguably requires Patient rather than Theme.

q2_gaps: Patient-vs-Theme for a terminative verb (abandon / give up) whose object is an ongoing event-denoting noun: the event-object list names scheduling verbs plus "call off", and it is not stated whether ending an activity already underway counts as changing "whether or when it happens"
notes: The passive is handled as specified — the by-phrase takes the Agent the active subject would have had, the surface subject keeps the object role, and the simple-present passive correctly gets no tense atom.
